notes.title: Remaster for other RPG coming soon
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Shamen![/h1]

Trials of Proelium, my first RPG, is getting remastered. If you enjoy A Shaman's Ballard, the remaster may be of interest to you as well.

The remaster will improve the weakest parts of the original title as well as adding and building upon existing mechanics. A lot of the improvements are based on your feedback for the original title.

Wishlist it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688030/Trials_of_Proelium_Remastered/]Trials of Proelium Remastered[/url]

notes.title: New game is out!
notes.content:
Hello shamen!

I wanted to share the news about my new game: Interballistic Symphony
It's a musical, fast-paced indie game all about speed and swift thinking. Featuring several modes like normal and marathon for casual plays, and endless mode with public highscore lists for the pro players.

Still missing my other games? You can now buy both Interballistic Symphony and my other games in the Retroactive bundle.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2569660/Interballistic_Symphony/]Interballistic Symphony[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29831/Retroactive_bundle/]Retroactive fort bundle[/url]

I wish you all a good week and happy gaming!

notes.title: A Shaman's Ballard V2
notes.content:
Hello Shamen! 

The game has been left unatended for some time admittedly, because not too many issues were found before. I recently replayed it though and did some tweaks.

[list]
[*]Fixed a few typos
[*]Fixed a few tileset issues (being able to walk where you shouldn't)
[*]A specific quest scene could be triggered multiple times. That should no longer be possible
[*]A store was selling the same item twice, removed the duplicate item
[*]The final boss takes no damage from fire, but could be affected by burning. This didn't make much sense and is no longer possible
[*]Some negative states took an incredibly long time to walk off and no text told players about the states disappearing. Now it should
[*]It should now be more likely to encounter some fishing mobs while fishing at certain locations
[*]Some other very minor tweaks to a few locations
[/list]

Both A Shaman's Ballard and Trials of Proelium can be bought in a bundle. Both games will be on a big sale during the upcoming steam summer sale. You can check that out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29831/Retroactive_bundle/]here [/url]

And on a final note, I hope you are having a great pride month! 🏳️‍🌈

Enjoy the rest of the summer!
